# What can be born next against what continues

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`what-can-be-born-next` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F07 · [record](what-can-be-born-next.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Of two courses of causal-set growth from the empty set, one includes the other's stems, what can be born next, exactly where its precedence is included in the other's, so widening adds no continuation. Read on what continues the inclusion reverses; no strict order holds both.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Sequential growth. A stem is a set of elements closed downward (Stem); a move chooses one and adds the element size, preceded exactly by it (birth, process), from the empty set (empty, empty_ordered). A birth keeps a causal set a causal set (birth_ordered), keeps the precedence below every existing element (birth_holds) and makes the new element maximal (birth_maximal). (`Becoming.CausalGrowth.Stem`, `Becoming.CausalGrowth.birth`, `Becoming.CausalGrowth.process`, `Becoming.CausalGrowth.empty`, `Becoming.CausalGrowth.empty_ordered`, `Becoming.CausalGrowth.birth_ordered`, `Becoming.CausalGrowth.birth_holds`, `Becoming.CausalGrowth.birth_maximal`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
2. Internal temporality, with the parent kept as it was, is holding the past: every move keeps the elements and the order among them (HoldsPast, step_holdsPast), so the possible with the past held, UE11's possible relative to a held part, is the whole possible (possibleHeld_iff). (`Becoming.CausalGrowth.HoldsPast`, `Becoming.CausalGrowth.step_holdsPast`, `Becoming.CausalGrowth.possibleHeld_iff`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
3. What each configuration admits next keeps widening on every course from a causal set. Every stem stays a stem across a birth (Stem.after); after each birth the stem of all elements is new (all, stem_all, not_stem_all_birth); so the stems keep widening in UE10's sense (ordered_of_run, keepsWidening), each possible from the course's start, inside a whole possible that never grows (stem_possible_from_start). (`Becoming.CausalGrowth.Stem.after`, `Becoming.CausalGrowth.all`, `Becoming.CausalGrowth.stem_all`, `Becoming.CausalGrowth.not_stem_all_birth`, `Becoming.CausalGrowth.ordered_of_run`, `Becoming.CausalGrowth.keepsWidening`, `Becoming.CausalGrowth.stem_possible_from_start`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
4. Stems reverse the inclusion of precedence. Of two configurations of one size, every stem of the first is a stem of the second exactly where the second's precedence is included in the first's (stems_included_iff); one direction takes the principal stem, an element and what precedes it (principal, stem_principal), the other is closure under the larger precedence. (`Becoming.CausalGrowth.principal`, `Becoming.CausalGrowth.stem_principal`, `Becoming.CausalGrowth.stems_included_iff`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
5. On courses. Along a course from the empty set the configuration at offset t has t elements and is a causal set (size_of_run, ordered_of_empty). Of two such courses, one includes the other's stems at every offset exactly where its precedence is included in the other's at every offset (rangeIncludes_iff), and strictly exactly where strictly, with no decision (rangeIncludes_strict_iff). (`Becoming.CausalGrowth.size_of_run`, `Becoming.CausalGrowth.ordered_of_empty`, `Becoming.CausalGrowth.rangeIncludes_iff`, `Becoming.CausalGrowth.rangeIncludes_strict_iff`)

6. Of two courses from the empty set, widening what can be born next loses precedence (rangeWidens_strict), and losing a pair, the precedence included, widens it (rangeWidens_of). One exceeds the other's stems where it lacks a pair of the other (rangeExceeds_of_pair), only where an offset's inclusion fails (not_included_of_rangeExceeds); decided, the pair is found (pair_of_not_included, rangeExceeds_iff_pair). <a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. Each law holds on every course of the growth, on every causal set, or on a witness; the comparisons take both courses from the empty set, and most fail without it (Starts); continuation_links_one_iff, continuation_links_one_of_rangeIncludes, pair_of_not_included and rangeExceeds_iff_pair take precedence decidable.
- Modelling choices: discrete steps; configurations finite and labelled, each element preceded only by smaller labels; precedence and pasts Prop-valued; courses compared at the same offsets and from the empty set, so the order on courses is labelled, pointwise, with no function extensionality; infinite causal sets read as courses and their limits; stems compared by inclusion, not counted.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That widening and continuation are opposed on every process: the reversal is shown on causal-set growth, labelled configurations compared at the same offsets from the empty set.
- Anything about transition probabilities, Bell causality, discrete general covariance as a condition on a dynamics, or the continuum limit.
- That continuation of a finer class read on links is ordered by widening: on witnesses it is gained and lost.
- How kinds of birth are ordered beyond the witnesses at offset 2; a count to five elements is a computation, not a law.
- Which course is better: with every continuation's losses counted the reading is on both together, where C ranks no two courses from the empty set; ordering them needs a measure, beyond C and the condition. AI readings.
- The second-order direction: every course keeps widening what can be born next, so a range whose widening keeps widening is not told apart from one merely wider now.
- **Counterexample:** The course of births with empty pasts includes every course's stems, and in it every element begins and ends in every class (antichain_rangeIncludes, antichain_begins_ends). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/CausalGrowth.lean)
- **Counterexample:** The antichain and the chain each widen the other on one of the two readings, so no strict order contains both (no_order_contains_both). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/CausalGrowth.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Read on links, a class continues from 0 to 2 in one course and not in a course it widens, nor in the antichain, which widens it (Finer.continues, Finer.not_continues, Finer.loses). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/CausalGrowth.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Two stems of the antichain whose births are of one kind, and at offset 2 neither extreme's kinds of birth among the other's (Kinds.antichain_two_stems_one_kind, Kinds.not_included_antichain_chain, Kinds.not_included_chain_antichain). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/CausalGrowth.lean)
- **Counterexample:** From one element, every past empty, a course widens the antichain's stems with the same, empty, precedence, so the strict comparison needs the empty start (Starts.fromOne_widens, Starts.strict_needs_starts). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/CausalGrowth.lean)
- **Counterexample:** The course bearing 2 above 0 exactly where P: where P is not refuted the antichain exceeds its stems, and finding the pair decides P, so finding it for every two courses is excluded middle (Undecided.antichain_exceeds_onlyIf, pair_converse_iff_em). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/CausalGrowth.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Two courses growing configurations of one kind at every offset from 2 on each exceed the other's stems (Kinds.wide_swapped_isomorphic, Kinds.wide_swapped_mixed). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/CausalGrowth.lean)

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Rideout and Sorkin's classical sequential growth (2000) read as a process: internal temporality as holding the past, their timid and gregarious children as the chain's and the antichain's births. That stems reverse the inclusion of precedence is the order-reversing correspondence between orders on one set and their down-sets, the specialization order of an Alexandrov topology; Birkhoff's representation of finite distributive lattices is a neighbour. Kauffman's adjacent possible (2000), as two reviews report his tentative fourth law, read for a prestated space as what can be born next, on the pasts and on kinds of birth. Discrete general covariance read only as relabelling. The calibrations, excluded middle for finding the pair a widening loses and for narrowing always widening what continues, are lemmas: which pair a widening loses is found by deciding. Graded in UE13's NOTE.
